;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[International military intervention against ISIL]]
**[[Denmark]] announces the partial withdrawal of its [[Jaeger Corps (Denmark)|special forces]] from [[Iraq]] following the collapse of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] in the country. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/denmark-pulls-special-forces-out-of-iraq-10243758 (Channel NewsAsia)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**The summit at [[Kīlauea]] erupts and sends a plume of ash and smoke {{convert|30,000|ft|km}} into the air. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/17/us/hawaii-kilauea-volcano/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44159856 (BBC)]
*A school bus and a dump truck collide on [[Interstate 80 in New Jersey|Interstate 80]] in [[Mount Olive Township, New Jersey|Mount Olive Township]], [[New Jersey]], U.S., killing two people and injuring 43. [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/school-bus-crashes-in-new-jersey/ (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**[[Quim Torra]] is sworn in as the 131st [[President of the Generalitat of Catalonia]], 200 days after the cessation of the government of [[Carles Puigdemont|Puigdemont]] and the direct rule. He does not swear on the Constitution and the Statute of Autonomy, but rather on "the will of the people of Catalonia". [https://elpais.com/ccaa/2018/05/17/catalunya/1526545933_327189.html (''El País'')]
*[[Burundian constitutional referendum, 2018]]
**Voters in [[Burundi]] go to the polls for a referendum to amend the constitution to allow current [[List of Presidents of Burundi|President]] [[Pierre Nkurunziza]] to stay in office until 2034. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/17/burundi-referendum-presidential-powers-tensions-high (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Poland]] detains Yekaterina C., a [[Russia]]n woman who was part of a pro-Russian group that sought to whip up tension between Poland and [[Ukraine]], and expels her. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/reuters-poland-breaks-pro-russian-group-seeking-fuel-tension-ukraine.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
